_about: laneOFFHAND: OFFHAND v2 (Assets/Scripts/Gear/OffHandWeapon.cs, PhysWeapon.cs hunks). A second, left-hand weapon for a dual-wielder. enabled = master (false: no item loads, today's game). slot = the gear.json slot of the off-hand weapon item (an item with a shield block stays ShieldMount's), bone = the hand bone under the roster bone prefix, socket = the node made under it (WeaponSocket_L). rows[] = per-fighter grip: socketOffset metres in the hand-bone frame, socketEuler degrees, slide metres along the blade, blendSeconds ease, states[] Animator states the row applies to (empty = default); name = the fighter (RosterResolver), item = the gear item id. attacks[] = which blade(s) a move swings for the contact point of the sparks and clash (R = main hand, L = off hand; no row = both): PRESENTATION ONLY, Duel.Resolve reads no weapon geometry (hits come from the move's reach x ReachScale, the same for either blade). Numbers: grendel_weapon.json grip.L (hand-bone frame from laneMONSTER3 fist_fit2 / grip_rows), blade contact hand from grendel_contact.json.
